name: dev-flow
description: Plan-first development for agent sessions — investigation series, reviewed plans, verified implementation, a sub-agent dev cycle that carries one change from plan to merge, multi-agent research fan-outs, chain-of-verification fact-checking, and a standing librarian that takes custody of a repo's work: files, dispatches, reviews and lands (soft dependencies: work-items; statusline-hub, for rate-limit reset times and the quota sense's usage readings from the sensor record it writes; claude-analytics (external, planned), whose sampler sink the quota sense reads as usage history, falling back to sampling itself into ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR}/claude-kit/librarian/; context-guard, for checkpoint and rehydration; kit-dev, whose update-kit takes the retrospective findings).
